description: Java class EcuTableDefinitionHandler for parsing ECU definition XML files to extract table and scaling attributes.

classes.name: EcuTableDefinitionHandler
classes.description: Utility class for parsing ECU XML definitions to retrieve table attributes.

methods.name: getTableDefinition
methods.description: Returns a map of table and scaling attributes for a specified table name from an ECU XML document and inheritance nodes.

methods.name: get2dTableMap
methods.description: Populates a map with attributes from a specific table node and its scaling node within the XML.

methods.name: addAttributesAsMap
methods.description: Converts XML node attributes into key-value pairs in a map.
